# Swypik

> Official product overview for the Swypik ecosystem.

Swypik is building a connected product ecosystem spanning video-native social commerce, local-first AI and an agentic desktop shell.

## Swypik

Swypik is a video-native social-commerce product. The web product is already running. A native mobile release is being developed separately and is not currently advertised as available in app stores.

## Ilaria

Ilaria is a Romanian-first, English-capable AI research stack with its own Go inference engine. Its verified project work includes local inference, tool use and hippocampus-inspired one-shot memory research. Ilaria is not presented as a replacement for frontier cloud language models.

## SwypikOS

The currently verified SwypikOS implementation is a native Windows desktop shell connected to Ilaria. A broader agentic computing platform is a product direction and roadmap, not a claim that a general-purpose standalone operating system is already shipping.

## Product principles

- Local-first intelligence where practical.
- Native software instead of a Chromium/Electron shell for SwypikOS.
- Clear separation between released capabilities, active development and roadmap.
- No public performance claims based only on architectural targets.
